start.text: The Spire's own book, open at the last written page, chained to its lectern.
Three names for the giving, and nothing given. The fast hand under them. Oriel Sayre.

first.text: 'The Hushed are not emptied. They are filled.' The oldest hand. Whoever wrote it wrote it carefully, like a rule; like something they'd thought about a long time and decided was all right.

last.text: 'One coal kept back. It goes down the stair tonight, in hands that asked to carry it.'
The ember sits in your hand and doesn't knock. Somewhere above you, a turn up the east stair, somebody hid their face.
